title: Solar Photolyzer
pages: Craft from sealed steel plates, Attuned Quartz, glass panes, a smithing table and a Resonance Infuser. This t6 FE apparatus recovers part of the ingredients locked in crafted utility blocks. Material update: crafting slot 4 (row-major 3x3) now requires a palladium ingot via forge:ingots/palladium; all existing progression gates remain required.

Twenty datapack photolysis recipes are exclusive to this machine. Fifteen reclaim portions of wood, iron, string or stone from different utility blocks. Four return the distinctive part of a block and burn away its wood: jukebox to a diamond, note block to redstone, cartography table to two paper and fletching table to two flint. No recipe yields more than ordinary crafting consumed. The twentieth processes a Sealed Steel Plate into Solar Foil, required at the Corona Collector upper-left corner.

Import from top and horizontal faces; export below. Set side Off/In/Out modes in the menu. Supply 20 FE/t or crank manually. Work takes 160 ticks and pauses when the output is full. Inventory, energy, progress and modes persist.

Datapacks add arcana_industry:photolysis recipes with ingredient, count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority. Higher priority wins; ID breaks ties. JEI shows the recipes and Photolyzer catalyst.
